correctness.rationale: Vovk's Theorem 2 gives the numerator bound \(m(B_a)\le c_3\sum_{k\ge a}2^{-g(k)}\). In the same primary paper, Proposition 1 gives \(m(H_a)=\Theta(\tau(a))\). The companion paper proves that \(\tau(a)/f(a)\to\infty\) for every computable positive decreasing \(f\to0\). Taking \(f=1/h\) (after a monotone computable normalization if needed) yields \(1/m(H_a)=o(h(a))\), so division proves the master conditional bound. The four displayed regimes follow from the same series estimates used by Vovk for Corollaries 3--6. The statement is mathematically sound.
correctness.risk: The formulation assumes the chosen diverging computable \(h\) is handled in a way compatible with the monotone-tail lemma; this is available by replacing it with a computable monotone minorant/divergence schedule.
